Hi Karthik,

We're preparing our renewal paperwork for ClearView and have two items we'd like clarified before we sign: 1) the proposed shift from a calendar-year term to a rolling 12-month term tied to the effective date, and 2) how "coverage" is defined for burst capacity vs reserved capacity in the order form.

Also, your legal asked us to accept a change to the data retention clause; we need a plain-language summary of that change and whether it affects our audit/compliance obligations.

Claire, thanks for the note and the projection file — helpful. I circulated this to Legal and Solutions. Quick summary up front:

- Term change: moving to a rolling 12-month term means the renewal anchor is the execution date rather than Jan 1. That gives ClearView flexibility but changes notice timing for price/SLAs; we'll reflect that in Section 2 of the MSA.
- Coverage and bursts: reserved capacity (4x) will cover baseline throughput; burst to 6x is allowed under the burst policy but is billed at the burst rate (per-token overage) and not covered by the reserved SLAs for the extra tokens. We'll add a short table in the order form showing reserved vs burst billing and which SLOs apply.
- Data retention: legal requested a clarification to limit log retention to 90 days for non-PII telemetry in hosted deployments; we'll include options for longer retention under Dedicated/Private with customer-managed keys.

I'm attaching a redline of the Order Form and an annotated MSA with line comments. Laura — can you review the data-retention wording and confirm the suggested customer-facing language? Aditya — can you add the proposed pricing table rows (burst rate, overage cap)?

Next step: Laura + Aditya to send a consolidated redline and a 1-page mutual action plan. If ClearView is OK, we'll push a final DocuSign envelope.

Karthik — thanks. I reviewed the MSA redline and the proposed retention language. High-level comments for the client (sending in plain language, please copy these into a cover note):

1) Data retention: we'll limit telemetry logs to 90 days for hosted by default. For ClearView to exceed 90 days we need a specific product addendum (Dedicated/Private) and an agreed KMS arrangement. This does not change retention for customer-controlled data or backups under the Order Form.

2) SLA/coverage: under the proposed language, reserved capacity tokens are eligible for latency SLO credits; burst tokens are chargeable at the overage rate and not eligible for SLO credits unless ClearView moves those tokens into a Reserved Pool via amendment. We should include an example calculation in the Order Form.

3) Term mechanics: rolling 12-mo term is fine; add a 60-day pricing/termination notice window so both sides have a change window.

I added inline comments in MSA_2026_redline_annotated.pdf and included a clean paragraph you can drop into the customer-facing cover email. Let me know if you want us to revert any of the redlines to reduce friction — my suggestion is keep the retention language but offer an escalation path for SOC/enterprise customers.

Laura Bennett
Sr. Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
